item.description:

Here’s an in-depth exploration of multiple methods to check if a key exists in your S3 bucket, along with practical examples and alternative approaches.

1. Using head_object

The most straightforward way to determine if a key exists in an S3 bucket is using the head_object method. This method retrieves metadata for an object without returning the object itself, making it efficient for existence checking.

item.title: Top 4 Ways to Specify an AWS Profile When Connecting to CloudFront Using Boto3
item.description: When working with the Python AWS SDK, also known as Boto3, connecting to AWS CloudFront can sometimes present a challenge—particularly when it comes to selecting the correct AWS profile. By default, Boto3 tends to utilize the default profile from your AWS credentials configuration, which may not be ideal if you have multiple profiles set up for different environments or purposes. This post addresses effective methods for specifying the appropriate AWS profile when establishing a connection to CloudFront.
